title: Element desktop data (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps the Matrix session, rooms and encryption keys inside its sandbox folder, where a native-only check will not find them.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app config lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/config; Element's Flathub id is im.riot.Riot: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same Element profile as the native install. The sandbox folder keeps the old Riot app id even though the app is called Element.

cleanup.exportFirst: Export any room keys or files you still need from Element's settings first: encrypted history cannot be read again without those keys.
cleanup.signOut: In Element, open All settings > Sessions and sign out this session, so the Matrix account stops trusting it.
steps: Uninstall the Element Flatpak from the App Center or from your Flatpak tool.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the Matrix session, the local message cache and the encryption keys inside the sandbox. Chats stay on the homeserver.
